key_highlights: ASX 200 set to open lower following Wall Street declines and surging crude oil prices.
Australian economic indicators deteriorate sharply as Flash PMI falls into contraction and housing auction clearances hit record lows.
Resource sector faces divergence: energy names supported by rising oil, while iron ore majors confront structural supply threats and margin pressure.
Property and construction risks escalate amid accelerating home price falls and private credit failures among developers.

sectors.trend: Crude oil rally providing counter-cyclical upside against broader market weakness.
sectors.implications: Short-term outperformance for domestic energy producers; margin expansion and dividend security.

sectors.trend: Heightened cost scrutiny, copper deal discounts, and structural competition facing Pilbara iron ore operators.
sectors.implications: Earnings headwinds for pure-play bulk miners; capital discipline and consolidation in critical minerals and gold.

sectors.trend: Property clearance collapse, steepening house price declines, and developer liquidity crunch via private credit fallout.
sectors.implications: Asset quality risks and reduced credit growth for major retail banks; severe de-rating risks for residential developers.

sectors.trend: Severe cost-of-living distress pressuring discounters, department stores, and retail food chains.
sectors.implications: Margin compression for discretionary retailers; defensive volume rotation towards lowest-cost grocery providers.

sectors.trend: Valuation reset and capital sensitivity driven by AI skepticism and high-profile corporate value destruction.
sectors.implications: Selective positioning required; scrutiny on free cash flow generation over speculative tech expansion.

key_themes: Macroeconomic stagflation risks from rising oil prices and contracting domestic flash PMI.
Structural property and credit strain from falling home prices and developer insolvencies.
Commodity market bifurcation between resilient energy/gold and pressured bulk miners.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocations to defensive dividend payers and cash equivalents; reduce cyclical domestic beta.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property Market & Private Credit Liquidity Shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic residential developers and lenders with high commercial real estate exposure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron Ore Supply Glut & Price Compression
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift mining weighting from pure iron ore producers to diversified miners and low-cost gold producers.
Hedge interest rate sensitivity; avoid consumer discretionary businesses exposed to leveraged households.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream oil and gas producers as an energy inflation hedge.
opportunities.rationale: Crude oil price strength provides positive earnings revisions and defensive cash flow during broader equity pullbacks.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to established gold producers amid active capital raising and safe-haven demand.
opportunities.rationale: Strong institutional interest and exploration support counter cyclical macroeconomic shocks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to residential banks and domestic property developers.
defensive_moves.rationale: Auction rate collapses and private credit liquidity distress elevate loan book risks and credit impairment charges.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce holdings in high-cost bulk iron ore pure-plays.
defensive_moves.rationale: Emerging global supply additions and rising input costs threaten dividend payouts and free cash flow yields.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and volatile 1–3 month outlook for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as contracting PMIs, falling home values, and oil-driven inflation weigh on local multiples.
market_outlook.long_term: Muted 6–12 month performance characterized by sector divergence, where earnings resiliency will depend on China stimulus, RBA policy clarity, and commodity stabilization.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy meeting statements and forward guidance
Quarterly Australian CPI inflation prints and mortgage stress metrics
Global oil supply dynamics and Chinese demand for Australian bulk commodities
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate volatility and growth shock indicators
S&P/ASX 200 Flash Manufacturing and Services PMI series
Capital city auction clearance rates and private credit default rates
Spot iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) and Brent crude benchmark prices
